const s=ctx.state,gl=ctx.gl;s.canvas=new OffscreenCanvas(1,1);s.c=s.canvas.getContext('2d');s.texture=gl.createTexture();s.program=ctx.utils.createProgram(ctx.utils.FULLSCREEN_VERTEX_SHADER,`#version 300 es
precision highp float;in vec2 v_uv;out vec4 outColor;uniform sampler2D u_image;void main(){outColor=texture(u_image,vec2(v_uv.x,1.-v_uv.y));}`);s.mount=()=>{const div=document.createElement('div');div.style.cssText='position:absolute;left:-10000px;top:0;width:512px;height:512px;overflow:hidden';document.body.appendChild(div);return div;};s.colors=['#57d8c6','#ffbc78','#ad9bff'];const mod=await ctx.utils.import('https://esm.sh/maplibre-gl@6.11.2?bundle');const M=mod.default??mod;s.workerUrl=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([await(await fetch(ctx.assets['maplibre-worker.cjs'])).text()],{type:'text/javascript'}));M.setWorkerUrl(s.workerUrl+'#maplibre-worker.cjs');s.div=s.mount();s.blocks=Array.from({length:30},(_,i)=>{const x=i%6,y=Math.floor(i/6),lon=126.953+x*.008,lat=37.547+y*.008;return {type:'Feature',properties:{group:(x+y)%3,height:100+((i*17)%8)*100},geometry:{type:'Polygon',coordinates:[[[lon,lat],[lon+.006,lat],[lon+.006,lat+.006],[lon,lat+.006],[lon,lat]]]}};});s.geojson={type:'FeatureCollection',features:s.blocks};s.map=new M.Map({container:s.div,center:[126.978,37.5665],zoom:12,bearing:20,interactive:false,attributionControl:false,canvasContextAttributes:{preserveDrawingBuffer:true},style:{version:8,sources:{blocks:{type:'geojson',data:s.geojson}},layers:[{id:'background',type:'background',paint:{'background-color':'#0b1625'}},{id:'blocks',type:'fill',source:'blocks',paint:{'fill-color':['match',['get','group'],0,'#57d8c6',1,'#ffbc78','#ad9bff'],'fill-opacity':.85}},{id:'outlines',type:'line',source:'blocks',paint:{'line-color':'#182e3a','line-width':2}}]}});await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{s.map.once('load',resolve);s.map.on('error',e=>{s.error=String(e.error||e);reject(Error(s.error));});});
